Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (stands up and starts to pace around the room) You don't understand me! You don't know what it's like to be me! 🌪️

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, stop this. You're not listening to me 🗣️.

JACK:
(outraged) I am listening! I'm listening to the voices in my head! And they're telling me to make you take the pills! 💬

DR. SMITH:
(skeptical) Oh, really? And what do these voices say exactly? 🤔

JACK:
(eyes flashing) They say you're not taking care of me! They say you're just trying to control me! And they're right! You are trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, I'm trying to help you. I'm trying to save you from yourself 🤝.

JACK:
(suddenly calm) Okay, Doctor. Prove it to me. Take the pills yourself. Show me they're safe. 💊

DR. SMITH:
(hesitant) Jack, I...I don't know if that's a good idea...

JACK:
(firmly) Do it, Doctor. Take the pills. Show me you're not afraid of me. 💪

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Fine. (takes the pills and swallows them) Ah... (pauses, looking around the room) Wait a minute... 🤔

As Dr. Smith looks around, Jack's face begins to fade away, like a ghost disappearing into thin air 👻. Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes that Jack was never really there at all 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) Oh no... Oh no, no, no... 🚨

The camera zooms out to reveal Dr. Smith sitting alone in the empty room, his eyes wild and his face twisted in a mixture of fear and confusion 😱. The screen fades to black as the sound of Dr. Smith's maniacal laughter echoes through the asylum 🎃.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
